Onikuma X35 RGB Gaming Headset with 50mm Drivers 

Immerse yourself completely in the action and experience high-fidelity acoustics with the premium Onikuma X35 RGB Gaming Headset. Available at Turbo Computer, this cutting-edge PC hardware audio peripheral is masterfully engineered for competitive esports players, professional streamers, and digital website managers across Egypt who demand crisp surround audio, seamless multi-platform connectivity, and superior comfort. Built with an ergonomic over-ear chassis framework to eliminate ear fatigue, this headset delivers a flawless blend of acoustic performance and long-lasting build reliability.

The Onikuma X35 Black is powered by massive 50mm dynamic speaker drivers tailored to project deep, recognizable sub-bass layers and highly accurate positional soundstages. It features a fully flexible 360-degree omnidirectional microphone layout integrated with high-definition noise reduction circuits to keep your voice clear and natural without distortion. For elite tracking endurance, the oversized earmuffs are lined with plush, soft materials that maximize air circulation. Complete with a gradual, radiant breathing RGB backlight effect and a heavy-duty 2.2-meter Type-C to USB interface cable, this headset provides universal compatibility across modern hardware setups.
